signals.text: 2 open PM roles across 1 US office

bullets: Build and run a roadmap across acquisition, activation, retention, and monetization. Choose the few bets that change adoption, and leave the rest.
Take features from ideas through launch across the product suite. Own the developer moments that decide whether someone succeeds: time to first working request, a useful error…
Analyze product metrics and use behavior to identify gaps and validate fixes
Work across engineers, marketing, design, and product to drive broad cross functional execution
Spend time with developers. Learn how they actually build, including auth, model choice, latency, cost, evals, and the first time a call fails. Bring that context back in a form…
Work directly with customers, from fast-moving AI startups to large enterprises, to find their highest-value use cases.
Map each customer's environment: data, existing models, latency and cost needs, and infrastructure.
Design and propose tailored solutions and proofs of concept that show the value of Fireworks in real customer environments.
Lead technical onboarding and implementation, including fine-tuning workflows, latency benchmarks, API integration and cost modeling.
Act as a trusted technical advisor, helping customers shape their AI strategy on Fireworks.
